user.title: Add a shutter
user.description: Select an existing cover supporting position commands. At load and after movement, the target adopts the equivalent actual position without sending a command. During reported movement it keeps your setting; without a known live position it is unavailable. Target position: 0% fully open, 100% fully closed. Buffer is the minimum difference in percentage points before a changed target sends a command. Adjust both sliders after setup.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure shutter
reconfigure.description: Change the name or select a replacement source. The buffer is retained. On reload, an idle target adopts a valid current source position. During reported movement alignment waits for stop; without a known live position the target is unavailable. Reconfiguration never moves a shutter. A removed registry source must be selected again explicitly.

init.title: Notifications and position alignment
init.description: Choose a Companion App phone or disable push notifications. For covers without movement status, set a quiet interval longer than the pauses between position reports. After this interval the target adopts the last position, without movement or notification. Covers reporting opening/closing use two seconds after stopping. Changes apply without reloading.
